product_summary: Signal Board Atelier is a highly polished, responsive browser-based decision board styled as a private strategy atelier. It allows small teams to add options, score them from 1 to 5 across customizable criteria, view a deterministic leader, and persist sessions locally. The interface features a calm, editorial layout with warm parchment backgrounds, charcoal ink typography, restrained brass accents, and subtle tactile depth.
architecture_decision: The application is built using a pure vanilla stack consisting of index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Data persistence is handled via LocalStorage. The UI is styled with custom CSS variables matching the atelier aesthetic (#FDFBF7, #1C1A17, #C5A059) and uses system serif headers. All icons are inline SVGs. Tie-breaking logic for the deterministic leader is implemented in pure JavaScript based on the highest individual criterion score, falling back to alphabetical order.

quests.objective: Establish the core HTML structure, the private strategy atelier visual theme in CSS, and the basic state management for options and criteria in JS.
acceptance_criteria: The page renders with a warm parchment background (#FDFBF7), charcoal ink text (#1C1A17), and brass accents (#C5A059).
Users can add and remove decision options via a clean, accessible form.
Users can add and remove customizable criteria.
The layout is responsive and adapts seamlessly from mobile screens to wide desktop monitors.
No external CDNs, packages, or web fonts are loaded.
evidence_required: The index.html file containing the semantic structure and inline SVGs.
The styles.css file containing the CSS variables, layout rules, and typography.
The app.js file containing the initial state structure for options and criteria.

quests.objective: Implement the scoring matrix, real-time deterministic leader calculation with tie-breaking logic, and automatic LocalStorage persistence.
acceptance_criteria: Users can score each option from 1 to 5 across all active criteria using an intuitive, keyboard-accessible interface.
A deterministic leader is calculated and highlighted in real-time based on the highest average score.
Tie-breaking logic is clearly defined and executed (e.g., highest individual criterion score, then alphabetical fallback).
Data persists automatically to LocalStorage on any change.
A confirmation dialog is presented before clearing or resetting board data.
evidence_required: Updated app.js containing the scoring handlers, leader calculation algorithm, and LocalStorage sync logic.
Updated styles.css with visual highlights for the leading option and tactile interactive states.

quests.objective: Refine micro-interactions, ensure full keyboard accessibility, eliminate console errors, and deliver the journey.json and README.md files.
acceptance_criteria: The application is fully keyboard-accessible (tab index, focus states, and keyboard activation).
Zero console errors occur during standard user journeys.
The journey.json file is present and documents a complete user flow.
The README.md file is present and provides clear setup and usage instructions.
evidence_required: Completed index.html, styles.css, and app.js with polished focus states and error-free execution.
The journey.json file mapping out the user journey steps.
The README.md file detailing the project overview and offline execution.
